top_signals.title: CFTC Chief Calls for Aluminum Pricing Reforms After Costs Soar
top_signals.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is examining how prices are set for aluminum, which surged to a record in the US this year and boosted costs for domestic beverage makers who rely on the metal used in beer and soda cans.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Nvidia is done with Jensen Huang. The fallout in Washington is just beginning
top_signals.summary: The Republican-led Congress wants to see Jensen Huang in Washington before Democrats take control in January.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
